item.description:
Share your availability by email.
- **Scheduling.** Turn on the calendar-clock button in the toolbar, then drag across the calendar to mark when you're free. Drag again to add more times, on any day; click a marked time to unmark it. - **Copy a snippet.** Copy puts your free times on the clipboard as plain text, grouped by day and ready to paste into an email. Times next to each other show as one range, like 9:00 – 10:00 AM. - **Pick the meeting length.** Choose 15 minutes to 1½ hours. The snippet names it, and leaves out marked times too short to fit it. - **Show other time zones.** Tick Time zones and add any you like. Each time then appears in every zone, with the weekday added where it falls on a different day.

A cleaner Recently Completed list.
- **Restore a task in one click.** Each row in Recently Completed now has a restore button on the right that marks the task undone. Right-click › Mark undone still works. - **Project icons lead each row**, so you can scan by project before reading titles.
Fixes
- The Recently Completed list no longer sits on a gray panel under its header. - No gray scrollbar track flashes when Recently Completed opens.

A new look for cards and popovers, and drag-and-drop between the calendar and the sidebar.
- **One card for tasks in the same slot.** Tasks booked into the same time show as a single card with a count and a segmented bar. Click it to see them side by side, reorder them, or drag one out onto its own time. - **Liquid Glass popovers.** Every popover is now the same rounded glass card, without the pointer tip. - **Drag a sidebar project onto the calendar** to block out time for it. The new block shows up right away, in Today if it's booked for today. - **Drag a block onto a sidebar project** to file it there. - **Calendar blocks are more solid**, and all-day events sit inset at the top of the day. - **Notes and links edit in place.** In a task's card, click "Add notes" or "Add link" and start typing. Return starts a new line in notes; click anywhere else to finish.
Fixes
- A task's title is editable on the first click. - A task card grows to fit its notes instead of cropping its top and bottom. - The insertion line when reordering a card's tasks is no longer cut off.
